caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular serving tray with slightly rounded and wavy edges. The tray is illustrated in a delicate, light beige or off-white color. Along the upper left side of the tray, there is a cluster of pink flowers with greenish-brown stems and leaves, painted in a soft, watercolor-like style. Another smaller grouping of pink flowers with similar leaves and stems is located on the lower right side of the tray. Both floral arrangements are delicate, consisting of fine lines and subtle shading. The edge of the tray is outlined with a faint gold line. The drawing is set against a plain, neutral background. There is a circular stamp with text and a small number in the lower left quadrant of the page, and handwritten text appears just below the center right of the tray.
title: Dinner Tray
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
